headword: {男女別学|だんじょべつがく}

definitions.explanation: An educational system in which boys and girls attend separate schools or classes.

examples.japanese: あの{高校|こうこう}は{男女別学|だんじょべつがく}だ。
examples.english: That high school has single-sex education.

examples.japanese: {男女別学|だんじょべつがく}と{共学|きょうがく}のどちらがよいか{議論|ぎろん}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: The debate continues over whether single-sex or coeducation is better.

examples.japanese: {埼玉県|さいたまけん}では{県立|けんりつ}{高校|こうこう}の{男女別学|だんじょべつがく}を{維持|いじ}するかどうかが{長年|ながねん}の{議題|ぎだい}となっている。
examples.english: In Saitama Prefecture, whether to maintain single-sex education at prefectural high schools has been a long-standing topic of debate.

notes:
A compound of {男女|だんじょ} (men and women), {別|べつ} (separate), and {学|がく} (study/schooling). While most Japanese public schools are coeducational, some prefectures (notably Saitama, Gunma, and Tochigi) still have single-sex public high schools, and many private schools remain single-sex.

The opposite is {男女共学|だんじょきょうがく} (coeducation), often shortened to {共学|きょうがく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {男女別学|だんじょべつがく}の{学校|がっこう}: single-sex school
- {男女別学|だんじょべつがく}を{廃止|はいし}する: to abolish sex-segregated education
- {男女別学|だんじょべつがく}から{共学|きょうがく}へ: from single-sex to coeducation

RELATED WORDS:
- {男女共学|だんじょきょうがく}: coeducation
- {共学|きょうがく}: coeducation (abbreviation)
- {女子校|じょしこう}: girls' school
- {男子校|だんしこう}: boys' school
